content.text:
**Finding: Compliant** — no non-solicitation covenant binds Corio.

- Searched the full text for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "induce", "recruit" and "personnel". No non-solicit, no-hire or anti-poaching language appears anywhere in the Agreement or Exhibits.
- Section 13 (Shared Resources) — the most likely home for such a covenant, since it seconds Commerce One operations, consulting and engineering personnel to work alongside Corio staff — stops at fees, ownership of Developments, employee NDA/invention-assignment warranties and a covenant not to sue. It imposes no restriction on either party hiring the other's people.
- Section 14 (Miscellaneous) and Exhibit D §5 (Personnel) likewise only address independent-contractor status and assignment of a sales/marketing contact.

This matches our preferred position (no non-solicit on the Customer), so no redline was proposed. If Commerce One later seeks to add a personnel covenant, our fallback is a mutual non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.
